verification.wheel_build: passed; module, schema and console entry present
verification.idempotence: five wrapper runs returned one identical snapshot SHA-256
verification.resident_process_check: no new Python process remained after the command exited

change_rationale.intent: Keep VKP's frequent Registry health check inside the 20-second budget without weakening detailed ASR diagnostics.
change_rationale.decision: Add a standard-library, fail-closed quick health path before environment, Provider and model setup; preserve asr-env-status as detailed diagnostics.
change_rationale.reason: Measured detailed ASR probes consume roughly 19 seconds while static command-surface health completes below 0.15 seconds.
change_rationale.evidence: Timing breakdown, six positive/negative tests, four preserved ASR contract tests, Ruff, wheel and five idempotent wrapper runs.
change_rationale.effective_scope: VKP local command-surface health and an unapplied Local Tools registry pointer proposal only.
change_rationale.rollback: Remove the early dispatch, quick module/schema/tests/entrypoint and restore the old health pointer; no data migration.

remaining_risks: Quick health does not and must not prove ASR, GPU, cached model or Provider readiness.
The Local Tools owner must separately approve and apply the registry pointer proposal.
Detailed asr-env-status remains intentionally slower and should use a diagnostic timeout of about 60 seconds.
